{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An expensive and [[Death/Legends|deadly]] '''airborne''' [[Poison/Legends|poison]] capable of destroying every being's soft tissues within a 20&ndash;[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius was produced with [[Schostri toxin]] dissolved in liquid by the [[Vagaari Empire]]. The poison was used by high&ndash;ranking members of the Empire as a last&ndash;ditch countermeasure.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The poison was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
